R10 AUDIO proposal (staging; agent R10-audio, 2026-07-17) on top of R9. W02: upbeat-1 outgoing fade_out_s 3.0 (much longer, ends earlier) + incoming upbeat-4 uses the new 1.2 global fade-in. W03: 3-link halo chain -> ONE composite sustained ahh (halo_vocal_book-1, built from pre-R8 halo_vocal-1) scoped to L36 only, re-anchored to L36 opening. W04: five-star boom removed. W05: music_present_db 9->10 in tokens (not here). W12: card fade 1.2->2.5 + global music_fade_s.out 0.9->2.5, .in 0.5->1.2, track_switch_gap 0.8->1.2 in tokens (engine defaults). Also revert sfx_pools.halo_vocal to halo_vocal-1 in tokens. PLACEMENT only; human ear-gates FEEL. Prior R9 _doc preserved below:

Unified audio plan (SFX / pause / music / dry) for 2026-07-04-poyais. R9 WS-D staged edit (exec agent D, 2026-07-17) on top of the R8 plan, applying Daniel's watch-through-4 rulings. PLACEMENT only; human ear-gates FEEL on the render. Anchors are verbatim VO n-grams (>=4 words for music from_anchor); the script was re-edited this round (Q08/Q14/Q25/Q27/Q29) but NONE of these cue anchors fall inside a replaced span. R9 CHANGES vs R8: Q05 jewellery cha-ching now rings INSIDE a 0.4s pause (in_pause) so a beat follows before 'There was just one problem' (cash-1 is 2.157s -> tail rings under the line; ear-gate the beat). Q06 new 0.8s pause after 'the prince of Poyais' (anchor 'And making things up was nothing new') for the arrow-spawn hold (E3 visual). Q11 halo_vocal now CHAINED x3 (fade_out_s 1.0) across the floating-book presentation L36+L37 ('a traveller's guide to Poyais' -> 'The book described' -> 'capital city called St Joseph'); the competing sparkle roll-up + its 1.5s hold at 'The book described' were REMOVED; the river-of-gold sparkle at 'the rivers ran with' (L41) is KEPT. Q13a five-star SFX changed ding -> boom + sync:element (matches the FICTION/SOLD slam family; boom is a consistent_sfx so it equals the stamp slam), lands on the E2 stars-slam element. Q15 removed the riser at 'the higher MacGregor pushed the price' (the 'roll-up' Daniel heard on 'nothing sells faster'). Q17 post-flag pause bumped 1.5 -> 1.9 (anchor 'A second ship, the Kennersley Castle'; stacks with the applause ring-out). Q20a removed the thud at 'that was one guy in a rented office' (the 'random whoosh'). Q12 music -2 dB handled in audio-tokens.json music_present_db 7->9 (NOT here). Q18 SPLIT the ~181s Cheery Monday block: upbeat-4 now ends at the new pt.2 card (fades out) and a FRESH sneaky bed 'Marty Gots a Plan' (sneaky-4) plays from the post-card shot 'He borrowed money in the name' (L64) to the existing Fig Leaf switch at 'In 1822...' (L73) -- ~31s, hands back cleanly, Fig Leaf onward unchanged. Q19+Q21 CARD MUSIC LAW: every interior card gets a music fade-out into it via fade_out_s on the OUTGOING music cue (card2<-upbeat-4#1, pt.2<-upbeat-4#2, card3<-Fig Leaf, card4<-underscore-1), silence during the card, the next bed enters on the first post-card shot. CONTRACT (agent B): fade_out_s on a MUSIC cue is NEW -- realizer must (a) fade that segment to silence over its last fade_out_s ending right before the co-located card pause, (b) keep silence through the card, (c) NOT coalesce a same-track resume across the card. Until B lands, build_audio ignores the key (graceful: no fade, no crash). card1 has no outgoing bed (cold open) so no fade. END CARD is EXEMPT (Monkeys carries the finale per R8-C; no next shot) -- FLAGGED for Daniel. Q30 card hold +0.6: all 5 card pauses 2.0 -> 2.6 (card screen-time == the co-located audio-plan pause per render-builder M3; hold_s in cards[] is fallback-only). Orchestrator/WS-C: do NOT also bump hold_s. Q26 human-cost dry pull-back RETIRED: both `dry` spans DELETED, music (underscore-1) runs through the entire back half; the comedic `buzzer` the dry span was suppressing at 'Then the rainy season came' was REMOVED too (comedy off on the deaths) -- the 0.8s somber beat there is KEPT. NEW pt.2 card pause + sneaky-4 must be mirrored in shots.motion cards[] (orchestrator). See visual-kit/audio-tokens.json for pools + dials.
